title: feat(ui-components): introduce `Carousel`
body:
**Summary**

This PR introduces the Carousel UI component. It is a port of the HorizontalSlider component designed. There are a few changes:

- HorizontalSlider is now named Carousel, obv
- Class names are prefixed with `ais-Carousel`
- References are not forwarded anymore, `Renderer` is extended to allow flavors to provide their `useRef` implementation
- Carousel CSS colors are now SCSS variables instead of CSS variables

This PR does not implement the Carousel as a built-in layout in any InstantSearch widget for now.

[**Preview →**](https://kq8txk.csb.app/)

**Before merging**

- [x] Remove carousel import in algolia and reset SCSS files
- [x] Remove changes to getting started
